test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What were the primary goals of the five-year plans in India?

options.text: Poverty reduction, Urbanisation, Self-sufficiency and Modernisation
Social welfare, Self-sufficiency, equity and industrial development

solution:
Correct Answer **Growth, modernisation, self-reliance and equity**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Planning Commission:**

 
• The **Planning Commission** was formed in **1950 **with **prime minister Jawaharlal Nehru as its Chairperson.**
 
• It determined the type of plan that would be best for faster economic development.
 
• The chairperson of the Planning Commission is the **Prime minister of India.**

**Functions:**

 
• Assessment of **material, capital, and human**
 
• Formulation of a plan for their most effective and balanced
 
• Determination of priorities and allocation of resources.

**Five-Year Plans:**

 
• Planning Commission had suggested that India should prepare a** plan covering a period of five years.**
 
• That is why India’s development plans are termed as **Five Year Plans.**
 
• It has four main objectives: **Growth, Modernization, self-reliance and equity.**
